THE MANUAL

THE BASICS
	THE MOUSE
		Left Button	+ drag :	At the begining Move the Camera around the center
		Middle Button + drag :	Move Toward/Backward the camera to the center
		Left Button :			POPUP MENUS
	THE MENUS
		POPUP		:	just read
						keyboard shortcut are sometime in

		PARAMETER	:	TAB	Toggle the visualisation of the PARAMETER MENU
						ARROWS	move in it
								
	THE KEYBOARD
		SHIFTLOCK	AVoid avoid avoid it will get you lost
		ESC			double it to save environement (nearly everything)
						and exit
		!			recall the last menu
		\		Toggle 4 views
		a			Axe
					Toggle the 3d axis display
						RED	:	X	0
						GREEN	:	Y	1
						BLUE	:	Z	2
					the Y axe (green) is vertical
		e		Erase
					Toggle Screen erase
		²
					Focus on Layers
		&
					Focus on Layer
		é
					Focus on Bdd
		"
					Focus on deformer
		ALT and TAB
					Toggle the bottom line and frame rate display

	THE KEYBOARD FUNCTION KEYS
		Voir Excel doc
		
	PARAMETER MENUS AND KEYBOARD
		The principle is more like an Excel grid where each
			colum correspond to a Parameter Set ( e.g. paticule, deformer, rendering)
			and each line to a different Parameter.
		You can move in the Grid with the Arrow Keys
		You can move in one Colum with the Mouse
		To change the selected Parameter (Green Color) use the Keyboard
			or directly the Mouse ( axe Down/Up and/or Left/right).
		The first and last line when the Parameter Menu is displayed show the
			Previous Current Next Colums names.
		The Title bar always reflect the current cell and the last operation done on it.
		The application switch some time automaticly the current colum.
		There is some shorcuts to select a colum using the function keys.

		TAB			Toggle the Display

		LEFT_ARROW	Previous Colum
		RIGHT_ARROW	Next colum
		UP_ARROW	Previous parameter
		DOWN_ARROW	Next parameter

		HOME		Default Value
		END			Inactive Value
		PAGE_UP		Maximum value
		PAGE_DOWN	Minimum value

		NUMPAD_/	Half value
		NUMPAD_*	Double value
		NUMPAD_-	Decrement value
		NUMPAD_+	Increment value

		NUMPAD_ENTER	Toggle sign
		NUMPAD_.	Closest integer value

		CTRL and LEFT_ARROW
				Previous Modifier
		CTRL and RIGHT_ARROW
				Next Modifier
		ATL and (LEFT_ARROW or RIGHT_ARROW)
				Toggle deformer active

		ALT and CTRL and UP_ARROW
				previous Layers
		ALT and UP_ARROW
				previous Layer
		ALT and CTRL and DOWN_ARROW
				next Layers
		ALT and DOWN_ARROW
				next Layer


THE	REST
	THE KEYBOARD LETTERS
		a		Axe
					toggle visibility
		ALT and a	Axe Origin
					toggle visibility
		b or B		Back
					3 state Toggle for the rendering of the backface
					FILL->LINE->POINT->FILL	
		c or C		Cull
					3 state Toggle for culling
					NONE->BACK->FRONT->NONE
		ALT and (c or C)
				Cull
					force to NONE
		d or D		Depth
					Toggle for ZBuffer
		e		Erase
					Toggle erase (allow trail)
		E		Erase
					Toggle ZBuffer erase
		CTRL and E	Erase
					Toggle Screen and ZBuffer erase
					and put them the same state
		f or F		Front
					3 state Toggle for the rendering of the frontface
					FILL->LINE->POINT->FILL
		ALT and f		
					Toggle global force_line
		g or G		Gouraud
					Toggle Gouraud
		h or H		MIDI
					send test data on MIDI
		i			3 state Toggle for the Mapping
						NONE->1D->2D->NONE
		I			Idem but reverse
						NONE->2D->1D->NONE
		ALT and i
					Toggle implicit texture (see rendering)
		k			close to i
					next texture (1D or 2D depending on iI) in Menu Bind
		K			close to i
					previous texture (1D or 2D depending on iI) in Menu Bind
		ALT and k		
					Toggle global allow_texture
		
		l or L		Light
					Toggle Lighting
		ALT and k	Light	
					Toggle global allow_light
		m		Model
					next model in Menu BDD
		M		Model
					previous model in Menu BDD
		n		Automap
					Automap ( Ask michel Bret )
		N		
					focus on special
					focus on MIDI
					focus on JOY
		o		
					Toggle camera perspective
		O		Optimize
					Toggle List rendering
					Infact freeze 3D Objet
		P		Print
					print rendering stat for 100 frames
		p		Pointer (cursor)
					Toggle pointer visibility
		ALT and p	Pointer (cursor)
					Toggle pointer visibility on the video zone
		q		
					Next program
		Q		
					previous program
		r		restart
					restart current Bdd
		ALT and r		Refesh
					Read from disk the current 2D texture
		R
					flip recording
		s		Snapshot
					write the current window image under the filename snapshot.tga
		ALT and s	Save
					Save ALL
		S		Snap
					focus on Snap
		ALT and S	Snaphot Toggle
					the real snapshot
					ask for the name ( e.g toto )
					save an animation according to the Snap Parameter Menu
					under numbered filenames ( e.g. toto0000.tga to toto0040.tga ).
					Pressing ALT and S during the snapshot, stop it.
		t		Time
					Reinitialize time to 0
		T		Time
					Toggle Real time
		v or V
					toggle draw curve
		w or W
					toggle Camera full screen
		ALT and (w or W)
					toggle Camera video mode
		ALT and (v or V)
					Toggle flying Camera
					Arrow and Numeric Pad drive the camera
		
		x y z		Align Camera on to the corresponding axe
						looking to the negative side
		X Y Z		Align Camera on to the corresponding axe
						looking to the positive side
		\		
				Toggle four views
